statement: Intel Data Center and AI segment revenue was 6.3 billion dollars in Q2 2026, up 59 percent year-over-year.
why: A 59 percent year-over-year jump in Intel data center revenue shows AI-driven compute spending is now lifting the third merchant supplier, not just the two GPU leaders.

impact.mechanism: Strong data center and AI segment growth confirms broad end demand for AI compute and widens the pool of available supply beyond the leading GPU vendors.

evidence.excerpt: The Data Center and AI (DCAI) segment posted revenue of $6.3 billion, up 59% year-over-year

confidence.basis: Primary source: Intel official quarterly earnings release.
